newsitem.title: ZAMBIA: Zambian stocks week - Zambia Sugar leads trade.
newsitem.headline: Zambian stocks week - Zambia Sugar leads trade.

text.p: Traded volume rose on the Lusaka Stock Exchange (LuSE) in the week ended December 6, exchange officials said.
They said volume rose to 143,506 shares worth 2,154,536 kwacha from 128,865 shares valued at 2,035,638 kwacha in the previous week.
Zambia Sugar remained steady at 11 kwacha in a traded volume of 104,147 shares worth 1,143,588 kwacha.
Rothmans fell one kwacha to end the week at 32 kwacha in a traded volume of 18,392 shares valued at 570,624 kwacha.
Farmers House remained steady at 220 kwacha and saw 50 shares worth 11,000 kwacha change hands.
Chilanga Cement fell one kwacha to end the week at 51 kwacha in a traded volume of 5,366 shares worth 274,814 kwacha.
Zambia Consolidated Copper Mines (ZCCM) was untraded.
